# 相續解脫如來所作隨順處了義經

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

T679 in one fascicle is [求那跋陀羅](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B1%82%E9%82%A3%E8%B7%8B%E9%99%80%E7%BE%85)'s rendering of chapter 8 of the *Saṃdhinirmocana-sūtra* — the *Rúlái chéngsuǒzuò shì pǐn* 如來成所作事品 (CANWWW T16N0676-8 / T16N0675-11) on the Tathāgata's accomplishment of his conforming activity. Companion piece to [KR6i0356](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0356) (T678), translated at the Liú-Sòng capital Jiànkāng between [求那跋陀羅](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B1%82%E9%82%A3%E8%B7%8B%E9%99%80%E7%BE%85)'s arrival in 435 and the Yuánjiā 元嘉 20 (443) translation peak.

**Abstract**

This text and its companion [KR6i0356](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0356) (T678) together form the earliest Chinese transmission of any portion of the *Saṃdhinirmocana-sūtra*, pre-dating the complete versions of [菩提流支](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%8F%A9%E6%8F%90%E6%B5%81%E6%94%AF) (514) and [玄奘](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%84%E5%A5%98) (647). The chapter-title 如來所作隨順處 ("the place where the Tathāgata accomplishes his conforming activity") corresponds to chapter 8 of *[玄奘's Jiě shēnmì jīng 解深密經](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0353)*. Together with T678, the pair seems to have been translated as a small exegetical excerpt — possibly because these two chapters were the most directly relevant to bodhisattva practice and Buddha-activity, the doctrinal centre of [求那跋陀羅](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B1%82%E9%82%A3%E8%B7%8B%E9%99%80%E7%BE%85)'s own translation programme (which also produced *[Léngqié ābáduōluó bǎo jīng 楞伽阿跋多羅寶經](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0327)* / T670, *[Yāngjuémóluó jīng 央掘魔羅經](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6h/KR6h0064)* / T120, and the *Zá āhán jīng* / T99). The terminology in T679 is in many places looser and less technical than that of the later [Bodhiruci](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%8F%A9%E6%8F%90%E6%B5%81%E6%94%AF) and [Xuánzàng](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%84%E5%A5%98) versions; for that reason it is an important witness for the early-fifth-century transitional Chinese Yogācāra vocabulary.

Related canonical recensions: complete versions [KR6i0352](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0352) (T675), [KR6i0353](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0353) (T676); paired extract [KR6i0356](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0356) (T678); other partial [KR6i0355](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0355) (T677). Commentary on parent: [KR6i0354](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0354) (X369 by Wǒnch'ǔk).
